title: docs(pm-dispatch): an exhausted contract-review tier hands the review to triage, and triage tracks stale records
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi97BMJshj8DqLK19hrY2xed1)_
Fixes #26667

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:契约复审归属加一条交接臂——派发席的 `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` 调用被配额拒时,不降档审,而是在 PR 落一行固定格式的 `Contract-review-handoff:` 交接,交分诊席跑;分诊每轮认交接行、自己的记录与现 head 比对,过期的重审或记一条。
- 为什么改:你 10-27 的原话「开发自己有 fable 时都可以自己审核,只有开发的 fable 用完了才需要分诊,但此时分诊要能看出来、区别出来」与「改进 skills」(分诊漏看 #26598 head 已动)。
- 风险与回滚:只改 pm-dispatch 两份参考文本与一个只读识别器;无门禁读交接行,队列守卫不变;回滚 = revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`references/contract-review.md`(交接臂与行形状)、`references/triage-duties.md`(分诊轮步骤)、`scripts/pm/record-recognisers.mjs`(`contractReviewHandoff` 与自检)。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm check:pm-record-recognisers`——预期 `✓ … 232 cases pass`,含交接行电池 13 例;`pnpm check:pm-skill-ratchet` 预期两文件行数不变(55 / 103)。
- 需要你做的:批准本 PR(Tier S draft,等契约复审与 GOVERNED_APPROVERS)。

## What changes

Maintainer rule, verbatim (2026-10-27): 「关于契约复审,开发自己有fable时都可以自己审核,只有开发的fable用完了,才需要分诊,但是此时分诊要能看出来,区别出来。」 and, after the triage seat reported a stale FAIL on a moved head: 「改进 skills」.

- `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/contract-review.md` 〈复核归属与资格〉 — two lines after 「谁跑 = 派发席」: the hand-off arm (a quota-refused `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` call never reviews at a lower tier; the seat posts the hand-off line, keeps `needs:contract-review`, and triage runs the review) and the line's exact shape, `Contract-review-handoff: triage — CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER unavailable (STATUS-OR-ERROR, UTC-TIME) · head SHA` (the placeholders are spelled in words here; the file carries the card's exact angle-bracket shape). In 〈等复核标记〉 the readers line becomes the relation rule: a label without the line is still the seat's own review and triage does not touch it; a head that moves after the hand-off needs a fresh line or the seat's own review.
- `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/triage-duties.md` — six round-step lines: list open PRs whose newest hand-off line names the current head and run the review in an isolated `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` subagent with the same-shape record signed by the triage seat; on triage's own quota refusal write once on the PR, keep the label, never review lower; each round compare every triage-rendered record's `Head-sha` with the current head (regen-only / prose-only moves excepted, judged on the committed tree); a stale FAIL is re-reviewed in the same round (every earlier must-fix, the delta commits as changes in their own right); a stale PASS gets one note that it no longer governs and a delta review is owed; the round record lists each triage-reviewed PR as `record head → current head → state`.
- `scripts/pm/record-recognisers.mjs` — ONE recogniser: `readContractReviewHandoff(text)` reads the line (target `triage`, the tier by its constant NAME through the same token reader `Served-tier:` uses, reason and UTC time in the parentheses, a 7–40 hex head; anything short of that is started-and-unreadable), and `contractReviewHandoff(rows, headSha)` answers whose review it is off the newest such line: `absent` (the seat's own), `triage` (names the current head, prefix-matched like a record's span), `stale` (head moved), `unreadable`. Newest governs through `latestMarkedComment`, the locator's own resolution. ⛔ No gate reads it; `locateReviewOfRecord` and the queue guard are untouched, and a pin drives the guard's reading past a hand-off line beside a record. A new self-test battery of 13 cases; `SELF_TEST_BATTERY_FLOOR` 12 → 13.

Line budget (the ratchet, lines only down; 120-byte cap, no re-wraps):

| file | before | after | paid by |
|---|---|---|---|
| `references/contract-review.md` | 55 | 55 | +2 hand-off lines, −2 (the read-only shape and the input set, lines 35–36 — both live verbatim in `--brief-template`'s built-in text, which the surviving line 37 points at and the self-test pins); the readers line (54) rewritten into the label↔line relation (its filter query lives in `dispatch-runbook.md` 〈跨账户复审〉) |
| `references/triage-duties.md` | 103 | 103 | +6 round-step lines, −6: emergency-triage authorization (→ `dispatch-runbook.md` 〈紧急卡直接分诊〉), the report-only-instrument close rule (→ `instrument-discipline.md` lines 8 and 12), lane seats do not triage (→ `lanes/skills.md` L22, `lanes/ui.md` L8, `cross-repo-coordination.md` L32), the three-exit first-touch + `Batch-of:` line (→ `filing-gate.md` L25–28), the three-state grading pointer (→ `filing-gate.md` L46–48), the 域分批 / 积压告警 pointer (→ `dispatch-runbook.md` L23/L27). The (c)-metadata lines and the routing line stay (seat review, head `5956f4ba`). |

The hand-off line in `contract-review.md` is 122 bytes as ONE code span — the card's exact shape, kept verbatim; the ratchet's `unbreakable` class (a single code span has no legal wrap) passes it, measured with `wrapLine`. Every other new line is ≤ 120 bytes.

No forced test edits. No changeset: `.claude/**` and `scripts/pm/**` publish nothing (`skip-changeset`).

## Tests

- `node scripts/pm/record-recognisers.mjs --self-test` — `✓ record-recognisers self-test: 232 cases pass` (219 before + 13 new), exit 0. The battery pins rows and strings only: a first cut also read the rulebook file to pin that it spells the line, and `check:pm-dispatch-gates` refused it (a structural read of a governed file from a script is a census that gate classifies), so that pin was dropped rather than the census widened.

## Acceptance notes

- `landing-operations.md` line 13 still says a review subagent that cannot start leaves the PR draft outside the queue with the maintainer's own review as the only bypass; the hand-off arm narrows the quota case out of that. Not edited (outside the card's file surface); noted for the seat.
- Item 6 of the card asks the recogniser to expose a record's `Head-sha` and `Reviewed-by` session. `locateReviewOfRecord(...).sha` already answers the head on the current head and `absent` on a moved one; the `Reviewed-by` VALUE is readable through the exported `REVIEWED_BY_LINE` regex's capture group — no second reader was added, per the claim's ONE-recogniser surface.

## Verification

Head `c59cd9c6`. `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` (no paths) derived 40 families; every one was run on this head with its exit code captured before any pipe, and `--ran` reconciled: `✓ dispatch-gates --ran: 40 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 40 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED`, exit 0. All 40 exit 0.

<details><summary>The acceptance families, verdict lines</summary>

- `pnpm check:pm-record-recognisers` — `✓ record-recognisers self-test: 232 cases pass`
- `pnpm check:pm-skill-ratchet` — `✓ check-skill-line-ratchet: declared cross-file moves: 3, total ceilings down 487 lines.` (contract-review.md 55/60, triage-duties.md 103/103, both unchanged in count)
- `pnpm check:pm-skill-id-lint` — `✓ check-skill-id-lint: 104 file(s) clean`
- `pnpm check:pm-governed-prose` — `✓ check-governed-prose: 2 instruction surface(s) name all 13 registered governed surfaces`
- `pnpm check:pm-dispatch-gates` — `✓ dispatch-gates self-test (fast tier): 1935 cases pass; 7 slow section(s) deferred.`
- `pnpm check:skill-frame-sync` — `✓ check-skill-frame-sync: the one declared copy of the decision frame is internally coherent`
- `pnpm check:nul-bytes` — `✓ check-nul-bytes --self-test: 75 assertions`

</details>

Not run locally: `pnpm lint` (repo-wide, CI's run), `test:repo` (CI's `Test Core`). No package is touched, so no ① closure and no ② package tests. Dogfood battery: n/a — no `!` in the title and no narrowing arm.

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic. (n/a — no schema)
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` is CI's run (repo-wide), not re-run locally.
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset — nothing publishes; both declaration lines are filled in above.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: no.
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English (the maintainer's rulings quoted verbatim).
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.
